name: Same Eli Firth
original_name: セイム エリ ファース
source:
2nd year high school student.
Sejm is [url=/c24822]Hinata's[/url] younger twin brother. He's non-serious, whimsical and insincere. As long as he's having fun, he doesn't care about if those around him are. Sejm has no interest in minor details nor the past. He hasn't thought about his own future for very long. Sejm excels in injurious magic (black magic).

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.p-reve.com/goes/#!/chara]official website profile[/URL].]
